sections.title: Section 1: Car For Sale (Mini)
sections.html:
advertisement

(noun). quảng cáo

They find the ad for the new movie quite funny.

quality

(noun). chất lượng

Please let us know your opinion on the quality of our service.

mileage

(noun). quãng đường xe đã đi được

This car has a mileage of around 23000.

owner

(noun). người chủ, người sở hữu

She's the owner of this shop.

tend to

(verb). thường

He tends to wake up at 7 every morning.

offer

(noun). lời đề nghị, lời trả giá

He made me an offer for my old car.

tax

(noun). thuế

If your salary is high, you'll have to pay more tax.

due

(adjective). tới lúc, đến kì

I have a report that is due next Thursday.

condition

(noun). trạng thái

My phone is in such a terrible condition.

tyre

(noun). lốp xe

Do you know how to change a tyre?

minor

(adjective). nhỏ, không đáng quan ngại

He has a minor paper cut on his finger.

mention

(verb). nhắc tới

He mentioned that he needed to go outside to smoke.

headlight

(noun). đèn pha của xe ô tô

It's getting dark, so we should turn on the headlights.

view

(verb). xem

They're viewing the house before they decide if they want to buy it.

straightforward

(adjective). dễ hiểu, không phức tạp

The process is very straightforward: you just need to follow these three steps and then it's done.

suit

(verb). phù hợp

I think this hat suits you.

sections.title: Section 2: The Treloar Valley Passenger Ferry
sections.html:
ferry

(noun). phà

The ferry is taking tourists to the island.

depart >> departure (n)

(verb). khởi hành, rời bến

The plane departs at 9AM and will arrive 3 hours later.

operate

(verb). tổ chức, quản lý

There are many things to consider when operating your own store.

differ

(verb). khác nhau

Opinions differ on this issue.

tide >> tidal (adj)

(noun). thủy triều

The tide is quite strong tonight.

seasonal

(adjective). theo mùa

Berries are seasonal fruits and only available in the summer.

cruise

(noun). tàu du lịch

I want to go on a cruise for my vacation next year.

combine

(verb). kết hợp

Let's combine strawberries with ice cream.

route

(noun). đường chạy

There's a beautiful bike route here which is right next to the lake.

wheelchair

(noun). xe lăn

She can't walk, so she uses a wheelchair to move around.

rail track

(noun). đường ray

Crossing the rail track is extremely dangerous.

booking

(noun). việc đặt chỗ, việc mua vé trước

She helps us to make bookings for our travel plans.

commuter

(noun). người đi tàu, người đi xe buýt

She's a subway commuter.

viaduct

(noun). cầu cạn, cầu vượt

This viaduct helps to connect the traffic between both sides of the river.

tower over

(verb). vượt xa, cao hơn rất nhiều so với những thứ xung quanh

The Landmark 81 building towers over other buildings nearby.

fare

(noun). giá vé

You have to pay the bus fare when you get on the bus.

valid

(adjective). hợp lý, chấp nhận được, chính đáng

Being sick is a valid reason for you to stay home.

unlimited

(adjective). không giới hạn

At a buffet, you can pay a fixed amount of money to enjoy an unlimited amount of food.

lay-by

(noun). bãi đậu xe, chỗ đậu xe bên đường

Why don't we park the car in the lay-by over there?

household

(adjective). liên quan đến việc nhà

She spent the entire day doing household chores.

cross

(verb). băng qua, vượt qua

You have to be careful when you cross the road with young children.

mill

(noun). cối xay gió

Holland is famous for its old mills.

renovate

(verb). cải tiến, sửa chữa lại

We're trying to renovate our kitchen by ourselves.

arts and crafts

(noun). đồ thủ công

On this table, we have everything ready to make some arts and crafts.

potter

(noun). người làm gốm

He's an experienced potter and has been making pots and vases for years.

refreshment

(noun). đồ giải khát

Please enjoy some refreshment on the table.

landscape

(noun). phong cảnh, tranh phong cảnh

The landscape of this area is amazing.

explore

(verb). khám phá

When I grow up, I want to travel and explore the world.

estuary

(noun). cửa sông

The river water changes color when it mixes with the sea water in the estuary.

sections.title: Section 3: Advice On Writing A Dissertation
sections.html:
dissertation

(noun). luận văn

In order to graduate from university, he has to complete a dissertation.

anticipate

(verb). mong đợi

They are anticipating good news from their friends.

degree

(noun). bằng cấp

He got a degree from a university.

material

(noun). tài liệu

I have all the material I need here to write my paper.

deadline

(noun). hạn chót

I need to finish my report before the deadline.

stage

(noun). giai đoạn

When we have a good idea, the next stage is to find more information.

frightened

(adjective). lo sợ, sợ hãi

I'm extremely frightened of spiders.

motivate

(verb). động viên

He's trying to motivate his friend.

tutor

(noun). người kèm riêng, người hướng dẫn

I need a tutor to help me improve my grade.

controversial

(adjective). gây tranh cãi

The issue is so controversial and everyone has a different opinion on it.

article

(noun). bài báo

Have you seen this article today?

fire up

(verb). làm hứng thú, làm phấn chấn

She's all fired up about her new job.

contradict

(verb). mâu thuẫn

They keep contradicting everything each other says.

reference

(noun). chú thích tài liệu tham khảo

At the end of your paper, you must always include a list of references.

draft

(noun). bản nháp

You should write a first draft and then read it again.

crucial

(adjective). quan trọng

It's crucial to keep following social distancing guidelines.

bibliography

(noun). mục lục sách tham khảo

Make sure to include the material that you have used to write this paper in the bibliography section.

outline

(noun). dàn ý

You should always have an outline for your speech, so that people can understand you more easily.

approach

(noun). cách tiếp cận

Let's think of the best approach to this problem.

chapter

(noun). chương

I've just started reading the first chapter of the book.

undergraduate

(noun). sinh viên đại học

They are studying for a bachelor degree at university. They are undergraduates.

recommend

(verb). gợi ý, đề xuất

I talked to my friends and they recommended me a few things that I should do.

access

(verb). truy cập

Nowadays, hackers can access private information very easily from anywhere in the world.

on good terms

(adjective). có mối quan hệ tốt

They are not on good terms with each other at all.

reliable

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

He's very reliable and he gains trust from many people

willing

(adjective). sẵn lòng

If you're ever in trouble, we're always willing to help.

collaborate >> collaboration (n)

(verb). hợp tác

Everyone in the team needs to collaborate on this project.

dependency

(noun). sự dựa dẫm

More and more people are developing a sense of dependency on technology and social media.

attitude

(noun). thái độ

It's important to keep a good attitude, even when in bad situations.

tutorial

(noun). sự hướng dẫn, sự giảng dạy

This tutorial is only open to a small number of students

worthwhile

(adjective). đáng giá, đáng thời gian

Although we don't get paid for doing volunteer work, the work is still very worthwhile.

sections.title: Section 4: Expertise In Creative Writing
sections.html:
background

(noun). thông tin nền

This is the background information of Elon Musk.

initial

(adjective). đầu tiên

After the initial step, you need to water the plant.

novelist

(noun). nhà văn, tiểu thuyết gia

Ernest Hemingway was one of the most famous novelists of the last century.

fascinate

(verb). làm kinh ngạc

He was fascinated by the stories that he read.

autobiography

(noun). tự truyện

Nelson Mandela wrote an autobiography, which was called 'Long Walk to Freedom'.

avoid

(verb). tránh né

We should avoid shaking hands in order to keep ourselves safe from the spread of COVID-19.

conduct

(verb). thực hiện

The students conduct many different experiments in their chemistry class.

lab(oratory)

(noun). phòng thí nghiệm

Scientists are working in the lab to find the vaccine for the disease.

guidance

(noun). sự hướng dẫn, sự chỉ bảo

She received a lot of guidance from her teacher.

investigation >> investigate (v)

(noun). cuộc điều tra

At the start of the investigation, the most important thing is to look for fingerprints.

practical

(adjective). thiết thực, mang tính áp dụng thực tiễn

It's important to teach students the practical uses of their subjects instead of just the theories.

extensive

(adjective). rộng lớn

The farm covers an extensive area of land.

novice

(noun). người mới vào nghề

Although you're just a novice now, with practice you will soon become an expert.

gather

(verb). thu thập

The farmer is gathering eggs from his chickens.

technique

(noun). cách thức

Remember to use the right technique to avoid hurting yourself.

experimental

(adjective). mang tính thí nghiệm, dùng để thí nghiệm

The new vaccine is still experimental, meaning it's not safe enough for the public yet.

assistant

(noun). trợ lý

She hired a personal assistant to help her with her many tasks.

recording >> record (v)

(noun). bản thu âm, bản ghi hình

She took a video recording of herself to practice her speaking skills.

compare >> comparison (n)

(verb). so sánh

There's no use comparing apples to oranges in this case - they are too different from each other.

generate

(verb). tạo ra

Turbines can generate clean energy from winds.

analysis >> analyze (v)

(noun). bài phân tích

In a research, you need to carry out data analysis.

framework

(noun). cơ cấu, kết cấu, bộ khung

The Plan-Do-Check-Act framework is one of the most commonly used framework in business and management.

evaluate >> evaluation (n)

(verb). đánh giá

They evaluated his performance by giving a score from 1 to 10.

editor

(noun). biên tập viên

She is the chief editor of a fashion magazine and has to decide which photos and articles will be published every month.

identify

(verb). xác minh, nhận diện

How can we identify the right person we are looking for?

sequence

(noun). trình tự, chuỗi, dãy

This picture describes the sequence of steps to make a sandwich.

expertise >> expert (n)

(noun). kiến thức chuyên môn

His expertise in technology makes him a valuable employee.

summarize

(verb). tóm tắt

Summarizing a long paper is not an easy task.

undergo

(verb). đi qua, trải qua

He had to undergo several surgeries last year.

gifted

(adjective). có năng khiếu

The teacher found out that she was gifted at mathematics.

adopt

(verb). đón nhận, chấp nhận để sử dụng

For some reasons, the company is not adopting the latest technology.
